title: Soul Snack #78: Are You Actually Enjoying Your Life?
excerpt: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
bodyHtml:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here


In this illuminating episode, Gary Zukav and Linda Francis invite listeners to examine one of the most deceptively simple questions of spiritual evolution: Are you truly enjoying yourself? They offer a profound lens for understanding why so many of us navigate the Earth School without genuine joy – and what it means to make a Responsible Choice to live differently.

Linda Francis reveals a powerful internal indicator: when you are not truly enjoying yourself, a frightened part of your personality is in command. 

The moment you notice this lack of joy is the very moment you are being invited to choose again.

The path is available in every moment: choose the loving part of your personality – the part that always enjoys itself – and create Authentic Power by letting it lead.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (00:02) — A New World, A New Choice: Gary opens with a vision of two worlds calling to each of us – one rooted in gratitude, patience, and awe (the new consciousness); the other in anger, worry, and despair (the old world of external power).
  • (00:42) — Your Enjoyment as a Spiritual Indicator: Linda shares a transformative insight: if you are not truly enjoying yourself, a frightened part of your personality is active and in control of your experience in the Earth School.
  • (01:12) — The Power to Choose: In any moment of non-enjoyment, you can make the Responsible Choice to consciously shift to the loving part of your personality, which always enjoys itself and aligns with your Soul.
  • (01:39) — A Daily Reminder: Linda shares that she continues to receive the same message in her own meditations: enjoy yourself. Even for those deeply committed to spiritual evolution, this practice is ongoing and worth returning to every day as you create Authentic Power.
  • (01:54) — One Happy Buddhist: Gary closes with a warm story about the Dalai Lama – a reminder that joy is not something to be earned through effort, but a conscious choice that reflects the frequency of the Soul.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

Pause and reflect: how much of your day are you truly enjoying yourself? The next time you notice tension, frustration, or a quiet sense of dread, stop and ask yourself – is a frightened part of my personality running the show right now? You don’t need to judge it. Simply notice it. Then ask: what would it feel like to choose the loving part of my personality instead? Try it once today – just once – and notice what shifts.
